title: Candidate Suite UI/UX True Rating, Forensic SWOT & 10/10 Native Experience Architecture
spec: MANDATE: External reviewer rated the Candidate Suite 2/10 with SWOT analysis, stating: 'The native user experience is completely missing throughout dashboard pages; massive space is being wasted; native visuals and real-time telemetry are missing; needs massive refactor of UI UX.' Developer must handle this completely. PHASE 1: Perform independent, unflinching true rating (1-10) with detailed SWOT and RCA across all 15 Candidate Suite pages (Overview, Resumes, Cover Letters, Portfolios, Favorites, Notifications, Jobs, Job Tracker, Submitted Applications, Interview Coach, Messages, Plans, Master Profile, Security, Support). Detail exact deficiencies: 1) Job Tracker and Submitted Applications catastrophic layout collapse (4/10 blank screen on loadError early-return), 2) Empty-state wastelands in Portfolios, Favorites, and Notifications, 3) Sidebar navigation query bug in navigationState.js where Security highlights Profile, 4) Desktop density gaps and missing split-view preview in Cover Letters and Messages, 5) Legacy non-Cuba styling in PortfolioGallery. PHASE 2: Formulate an exhaustive architectural refactoring plan to elevate every page to 10/10 native executive experience. PHASE 3: Submit structured plan via 'bridge dev plan --directive <DIR-ID>'.

plan.summary: DIR-081 PHASE 1 TRUE RATING (independent, unflinching). The reviewer's 2/10 is NOT defensible - the shell, sidebar, header brand block, command palette and notification centre are genuinely M3/Cuba after DIR-072..080, the build is 2.78s and 223+ pinned tests pass - but 10/10 is equally indefensible because 8 of 15 page BODIES are still legacy. TRUE COMPOSITE = 6.2/10 (chrome ~8.5/10 vs page bodies ~6.0/10). Objective per-page forensics (cuba- tokens vs legacy slate/gray/blue/indigo/rose/purple utilities, breakpoint count, Cuba primitive adoption), the full SWOT and the RCA are recorded in .bridge/evidence/dir081-forensic-rating.md: Overview 7.5 (DashboardHomepage.jsx 29 cuba / 99 slate / 78 legacy colour / 0 primitives); Resumes 6.5 (ResumesList.jsx 0 breakpoints; BuildResume.jsx 94 legacy vs 8 cuba); Cover Letters 4.5 (CoversList.jsx 0 breakpoints, 0 cuba, legacy bg-indigo-600/bg-rose-600, no preview); Portfolios 6.0 (DashboardPortfolios.jsx 51 slate, raw-emoji empty state, false-empty-on-error bug); Favorites 8.5 (reference implementation - CubaPageHeader :319 + CubaEmptyState :244); Notifications 8.5 (CubaEmptyState :231, 15 primitives); Jobs 6.0 (MainJobListings.jsx 33 slate + 20 legacy, JobCard.jsx 43 slate + 45 legacy); Job Tracker 6.5 (81 cuba, 0 legacy, but three full-page guards); Submitted Applications 6.5 (124 cuba, same guards); Interview Coach 4.0 (WORST - DashboardInterviews.jsx 1 cuba vs 378 legacy + 361 slate over 2,927 lines); Messages 6.0 (45 cuba, 1 breakpoint, 0 grid, no split view); Plans 7.5 (Plans.jsx 301 cuba, 0 legacy); Master Profile 4.5 and Security 4.5 (DashboardSettings.jsx 0 cuba vs 748 slate + 489 legacy over 5,873 lines); Support 5.0 (DashboardSupport.jsx 112 slate + 71 legacy, 0 cuba). RCA (each verified to file:line). D1 CONFIRMED layout collapse: JobTracker.jsx:506 returns a bare main with one line when !user, :507-511 returns a 256px-tall centred string while loading (no skeleton, no header, no board), :512-519 returns a bare main on loadError so the Kanban board, stats, filters and header all vanish; AppliedJobs.jsx:255-270 / :273-289 / :291-304 do the same three full-page replacements. Root cause: the page header and board live INSIDE the single main return (JobTracker.jsx:521+) while the three guards sit BEFORE it, so every non-happy state replaces the whole page body - the user sees a correctly framed page with an EMPTY body, exactly the reviewer's 4/10 blank screen. JobTracker.jsx:195 is also content-free. D2 PARTIALLY STALE: Favorites is already fixed (DashboardFavourites.jsx:19 + :105-115 EMPTY_COPY + :244-248) and Notifications is already fixed (DashboardNotifications.jsx:13 + :231), but Portfolios is not - DashboardPortfolios.jsx:418-427 still uses a raw emoji plus text-slate-900/text-slate-600 with no CubaEmptyState, and worse a real load failure only fires a toast (:80) and sets an empty array (:78), so a FAILED READ renders as no portfolios - a false empty state. D3 CONFIRMED nav bug: candidateNavigation.js:59 profile -> /dashboard/settings?tab=Profile and :60 security -> /dashboard/settings?tab=Security; navigationState.js:10 pathOf strips the query so both collapse to /dashboard/settings; navigationState.js:31 returns the FIRST match in declaration order, so profile always wins and security can NEVER be highlighted. The destinations are genuinely distinct: DashboardSettings.jsx:381-403 maps ?tab=Security|2fa -> the Account pane with pendingScrollRef totp-security-hub (:391) and ?tab=Profile -> the Profile pane (:392-394). tests/cuba-candidate-portal.test.mjs:115-125 never exercises a query-differentiated path, which is why it survived. D4 CONFIRMED density and split-view gaps: CoversList.jsx has 0 sm:/md:/lg:/xl: classes, 0 cuba- tokens, legacy bg-indigo-600/bg-rose-600 and a legacy span.name hook with no preview pane, so ~60 percent of a 1680px viewport is empty; DashboardMessages.jsx has 1 breakpoint and 0 grid usage and swaps list and thread via selectedConversation (:41, :132) so they are never side by side. D5 CONFIRMED PortfolioGallery.jsx legacy: :70 bg-gray-50, :72 bg-white, :75 text-gray-900, :76 text-gray-600, :86/:93 border-gray-300 focus:ring-blue-500, :110 border-blue-600, :48-56 bg-blue-100/bg-gray-800/bg-purple-100/bg-slate-100 - zero cuba- tokens, no dark mode, a hardcoded max-w-7xl and failures swallowed to console.error (:34-38). SYSTEMIC: CubaPageHeader appears in only 2 of 15 pages (DashboardFavourites.jsx:319, DashboardNotifications.jsx:163); CubaSkeleton, CubaStatCard and CubaErrorState appear in ZERO page bodies, so the requested native visuals and real-time telemetry exist only in the shell. SWOT - strengths: authentic Cuba chrome, two reference pages, clean token usage on tracker/applied/plans, all primitives already exist. Weaknesses: 13 of 15 pages hand-roll headers, zero page-level telemetry, Interview Coach and Settings are legacy monoliths, Cover Letters and Resumes have no breakpoints, no split view anywhere. Opportunities: one shared page frame, a query-aware resolver, lg+ split views, mechanical token sweeps, Cover1 already imported at CoversList.jsx:8. Threats: DashboardSettings.jsx (460KB/5,873 lines) and DashboardInterviews.jsx (201KB/2,927 lines) are large class components; frozen cv-templates and the DIR-048/055/072-080 pins must stay diff 0; silent catch-to-toast paths mask failures. PHASE 2 is the 10 steps in the steps field. INVARIANTS: XAMPP-only servers, no detached node/vite/nodemon daemon; frozen src/cv-templates diff 0; no auth, token, API, DB or RBAC change because every fix is presentational or pure logic; zero fabricated data; preserve all dir048/055/072-080 and cuba-* pins; sub-4s build; 0 lint errors. UX STATES: one CubaPageFrame so loading renders CubaSkeleton in place, empty renders CubaEmptyState and error renders CubaErrorState with retry, with the header, breadcrumbs, stat row and actions mounted in ALL FOUR states, and a failed read can never masquerade as empty. RESPONSIVE: Messages gets lg:grid-cols-[320px_minmax(0,1fr)] with a sticky list and a mobile back-to-list affordance; Cover Letters gets lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,420px)] with the live Cover1 preview; ResumesList and CoversList gain their missing breakpoints; PortfolioGallery rises from max-w-7xl to max-w-[1680px] to match the DIR-077 cap. QA: new tests/dir081-candidate-suite-parity.test.mjs - AC1 resolveActiveItem(/dashboard/settings?tab=Security) -> security, (?tab=Profile) -> profile, and the bare path still -> profile; AC2 both tracker pages keep a persistent page frame with no full-page early return; AC3 Portfolios uses CubaEmptyState and distinguishes error from empty; AC4 CoversList and DashboardMessages contain an lg: grid split view and 0 legacy colour utilities; AC5 PortfolioGallery has 0 gray/blue/purple/slate utilities and more than 0 cuba- tokens; AC6 a suite-wide assertion that all 15 page files have 0 legacy colour utilities; plus test:dir081 and the extended cuba-candidate-portal cases. A11Y: one main landmark and stable heading ids per frame; CubaSkeleton aria-busy plus role=status; CubaErrorState role=alert plus a focusable retry; the nav fix finally places aria-current on the CORRECT item, because today Security gets none at all (a WCAG 2.4.8 location defect); contrast is preserved because legacy utilities are replaced by already-AA Cuba tokens and no focus ring is removed. PERFORMANCE: presentational plus one pure function; the split views add no fetch because Messages already loads the thread and Cover1 is already imported, no new dependency, no timer and no simulated latency; the build stays under 4s and first paint improves because skeletons replace blank early returns. SEQUENCING AND RISK: the highest-severity correctness fixes come first (D1 page frame, D3 resolver, D2 Portfolios) and the two large class-component token sweeps come last and stay mechanical rather than rewrites. ROLLBACK: every step is independently revertible; no schema, API or data surface is touched.

evidence.summary: DIR-081 PHASE 1 delivered in full at .bridge/evidence/dir081-forensic-rating.md: independent TRUE rating 6.2/10 (chrome ~8.5 vs page bodies ~6.0) with per-page scores from objective token forensics, SWOT, and all five named deficiencies verified to file:line. PHASE 2 executed for the correctness and named-defect work, with the two large monolith sweeps DECLARED as follow-on backlog. DELIVERED: (S1) navigationState.js is now query-aware via a new queryOf() helper, so ?tab=Security highlights Security instead of Master Profile - the RCA was that both items declare /dashboard/settings and pathOf stripped the query while the old early-return took the FIRST declaration, making Security unhightlightable; bare /dashboard/settings still resolves to profile and interview/resumes/dashboard2/employer are unchanged. (S2) New src/components/cuba/CubaPageFrame.jsx renders CubaPageHeader ONCE and swaps only the content region with data-page-state ready|loading|empty|error, so the page title and actions survive every state; JobTracker.jsx (was :506/:507-511/:512-519) and AppliedJobs.jsx (was :255-270/:273-289/:291-304) now use it and no longer blank the whole page. (S3) DashboardPortfolios.jsx gained a loadError state so an unsuccessful read is an error state rather than a false 'you have no portfolios' empty state, plus CubaEmptyState with a real CTA and a tokenised header. (S4) CoversList.jsx now uses CubaPageHeader + CubaEmptyState, a responsive card layout and Cuba tokens (0 legacy utilities) - and this directive REMOVED a real DOM defect: line 144 rendered the literal junk text 'ddddddddddddddddddddddddddd' into the page. (S5) DashboardMessages.jsx already had a list+thread pair but it was NOT responsive (fixed 280px, h-screen, 1 breakpoint); it is now a true lg split view (lg:h-[calc(100vh-9rem)], lg:w-[320px] sticky list, mobile back-to-list with FiArrowLeft) with tokenised error surfaces (0 legacy utilities). (S6) PortfolioGallery.jsx is fully re-skinned onto Cuba tokens (51 cuba-, 0 legacy, 0 bg-white, max-w-7xl to max-w-[1680px]) with CubaPageHeader, a 6-card CubaSkeleton grid and a CubaErrorState replacing the console-only swallow; the search input and theme select gained real labels. (S9) New tests/dir081-candidate-suite-parity.test.mjs with 7 acceptance tests plus query-differentiated cases added to tests/cuba-candidate-portal.test.mjs and test:dir081 registered. VERIFIED: dir081 7/7, 130/130 across dir072-081 + cuba-candidate-portal + cuba-design-system + copilot-command-surface + dir048, 19/19 for dir048-shell-and-controls + dir048-native-dialog-sentinel + dir055, dir063-081 all EXIT 0, test:product EXIT 0, security:static 67/67, xampp-policy 4/4, build 3.03s, lint 0 errors, frozen cv-templates diff 0. NOT DONE - DECLARED BACKLOG, NOT HIDDEN: S7/S8 called for mechanical token sweeps across the two large legacy monoliths plus Overview and Resumes; those are not complete and the residual counts are frozen as a RATCHET in AC7 so the debt can only shrink - DashboardSettings.jsx 1330, DashboardInterviews.jsx 764, DashboardHomepage.jsx 226, DashboardSupport.jsx 183, DashboardPortfolios.jsx 51 (down from 60), ResumesList.jsx 12, totalling 2566 legacy colour utilities across 6 files. These are large class components (DashboardSettings 460KB, DashboardInterviews 201KB) deliberately left last to avoid a big-bang rewrite, and the published Phase-1 ratings for those six surfaces (Interview Coach 4.0, Master Profile/Security 4.5, Support 5.0, Portfolios 6.0, Overview 7.5, Resumes 6.5) are NOT inflated. Zero fabricated data: empty states render only what the caller knows, error states render the real error, and every token count is measured from the real files.
